verdict.rationale: Airweave is a context and retrieval layer for agents, so shared-versus-private memory scoping is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows collections grouping data sources behind one search endpoint and Connect letting end users link their apps. Nothing documents per-user or per-agent permissions, shared team scopes, or isolation of private data. A community commenter's open question about how RBAC will be solved is skepticism, not evidence either way.
